content.comment_body: I have a [company_name] USB programming cable, purchased [product_name] [version_no], and a [product_name] PLC with [article_no]. My hardware is set to [article_no].[version_no]. Firmware version states [article_no].[version_no] V1.07.07. I can connect to the PLC and transfer programs from the PLC to my computer, and general connectivity works with the PLC. However, I am unable to load programs to the PLC. The PLC only presents a card option instead of a PC option on its screen. How can I load programs onto the PLC?
Could you please share a screenshot of the error message?
Hello [user_name], Is the software you are using a trial version of [product_name]?

Hi. I'm struggling to follow your question completely. To clarify, can I assume you purchased: (a) PLC: [product_name] [article_no] ([version_no]), (b) Software: [product_name] [version_no], (c) USB programming cable? You mentioned that you can connect your PC to the PLC and upload a program from PLC to PC, but are facing issues downloading a program from PC to PLC. I suspect the software may not be set to the correct [product_name] version yet. When creating a project, make sure to specify your hardware version. Go to File > Properties (see image) and Offline settings > Hardware type > [article_no].[version_no] (see image). It's crucial to select the correct sub-version to avoid connection issues. Did this suggestion help?
I believe I have already selected the correct hardware. Screenshot attached for clarification.

Thanks for the quick replies everyone! I've identified the issue. I had a disconnected block in my program related to displaying information, and didn't realize it needed to be connected to an open connector. This was preventing the program from uploading. The program has now uploaded successfully to the PLC. Thank you again!

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered difficulties transferring a program from their computer to a PLC using [product_name] [version_no] software, a USB cable, and the corresponding PLC. While connections and uploading from PLC to PC worked, the option to load a program from PC to PLC was not available, leading to confusion. The underlying issue was an incomplete program with an unconnected block which stopped the upload process. This highlights the need for clear error feedback and more intuitive notifications within the programming software interface.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected to easily transfer programs between PC and PLC using the supplied software and hardware. Additionally, the user anticipated clear instructions and feedback within the software and device when transfer operations failed.
